steps.text: Fed. R. App. P. 26(a)(1)(A): exclude the trigger date {trigger}

periods.text: Fed. R. App. P. 26(a)(1)(B): count {n} calendar day(s) {after} the trigger, including weekends/holidays -> {date}
court days: advance {n} business day(s) {forward} from {trigger} (skipping weekends/holidays) -> {date}

forward.text: Fed. R. App. P. 26(a)(1)(C): last day fell on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday; roll forward -> {date}

backward.text: Fed. R. App. P. 26(a)(5): last day fell on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday; roll backward -> {date}

steps.text: Fed. R. App. P. 26(d)/(c): service by {method} adds {days} day(s) (after the period expires under the counting rule) -> {date}
steps.backwardText: Fed. R. App. P. 26(d)/(c) does not apply to backward-counted periods; ignored

forward.text: Fed. R. App. P. 26(a)(1)(C): last day fell on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday; roll forward -> {date}

backward.text: Fed. R. App. P. 26(a)(5): last day fell on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday; roll backward -> {date}

steps.text: Fed. R. App. P. 26(a)(3)(A): clerk's office inaccessible on the last day; extend to the first accessible day that is not a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday -> {date}
steps.ignoredText: clerk_inaccessible requested but Fed. R. App. P. 26(a)(3) is not applied to backward-counted periods (see packs/clock/SOURCES-NOTES.md); ignored

hours.text: Fed. R. App. P. 26(a)(2)(A)-(B): begin counting immediately on the triggering event and count every hour, including intermediate Saturdays, Sundays, and legal holidays; +{n} hour(s)
hours.rollText: Fed. R. App. P. 26(a)(2)(C): period would end on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday; continue to the same time on {date}
hours.inaccessibleText: Fed. R. App. P. 26(a)(3)(B): clerk's office inaccessible during the last hour; extend to the same time on the first accessible day that is not a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday -> {date}
